rounds.name: The Party
rounds.screen: Welcome to Braun Manor. Mingle. Introduce yourself. Enjoy the evening.
mechanics: Host (Braun) explains phones, map tab, notes tab, badge scanning — framed as party novelty.
Badge scans begin populating the interaction graph.

rounds.name: The Murder
rounds.screen: WHITE FLASH → lightning crack → the scream.
mechanics: Facilitators kill the lights and place all 9 physical clue QRs (pre-printed per this game's generation).
Braun's player exits play; switches to game-master screen.
Roles, factions, briefings, and cover stories push to all phones.
Main screen: the study scene text. The bloody QR is live at the study for anyone who walks there.

rounds.name: Investigation
rounds.screen: James Braun is dead. His body is missing. Everyone here saw something. Find out what.
mechanics: Witness statements live on each phone: 2-3 facts about co-located characters.

rounds.name: The House Settles
rounds.screen: Announces IF any clue has been tampered with (never which).

rounds.name: Last Hours
rounds.screen: Tampering status update. The walls feel closer.

rounds.name: The Whole Truth
rounds.screen: Full solution: the killers, the method, the route, the order. Then every faction, every winner — jesters and Braun claimants folded into the winners' list here, first anyone's heard of it.
mechanics: Reveal order: the murder reconstruction → killers → minions → detectives → jesters → Braun claim → winners list.

trial_procedure.phase_1: Open vote, 3 minutes, all living players, on phones. Live tally on main screen as silhouettes, not names, until close.
trial_procedure.phase_2: Top 4 vote-getters are nominated. Ties at the cut: all tied players nominated.
trial_procedure.phase_3: Each nominee gets 45 seconds of final words. Order: fewest votes first.
trial_procedure.phase_4: Final vote among nominees only, 2 minutes. Every living non-nominee votes.
trial_procedure.phase_5: Top 2 convicted. Tie at the cut: revote between tied players only; if still tied, the earlier open-vote tally decides.
trial_procedure.phase_6: Conviction reveal: faction card on the main screen. Killers show as KILLER (unless blame-taken). Minions as SYNDICATE ASSOCIATE. Jesters and Braun claimants show as GUEST. Detectives and villagers show as GUEST. Full truth waits for endgame.
trial_procedure.early_end: Town wins at 2+ killers convicted, but that is evaluated after the third trial — reaching 2 does NOT stop play, and the room is not told it has already won. The game ends early only if all 3 killers are convicted (truly — blame-take suppresses the tick), because at that point there is nothing left to catch: straight to reveal. Jesters and Brauns who haven't scored by then are out of time — they know this, and it should make them reckless.

reveal_card_note: Non-killer convictions all show as GUEST during play. Revealing 'detective' or 'villager' mid-game hands the killers a kill-list confirmation for free; revealing 'jester' ends the fun of the silent win. GUEST keeps every conviction ambiguous.
